selection_recompute.score_units: delta AEE per million M280 positive-distance approximated partitions

findings.title: Duplicate command-line options bypass the M309 audited values
findings.evidence: M309's option() reads the first occurrence, but it forwards duplicate --contract, --distance-threshold, --max-samples and --bn-policy options to argparse, whose store action uses the last occurrence. A directed smoke shows direct --max-samples 10 is rejected, while '--max-samples 0 --max-samples 10' passes M309 and reaches the downstream wrapper. A first valid contract plus a later modified M284-schema contract can likewise change the downstream root contract and admitted tau.
findings.impact: The frozen full-valid825/tau1/contract boundary is not fail-closed; an invocation can pass launcher audit and execute different downstream semantics.
findings.required_fix: Reject duplicate security-relevant options, parse once into a normalized namespace, remove/replace all forwarded values, and exact-pin the candidate contract in a launch manifest. Add wrong duplicate-contract, tau, sample and BN attacks.

findings.title: Accuracy promotion trusts an unbound baseline profile
findings.evidence: The M309 launcher neither requires nor pins --baseline-profile/--baseline-per-frame. The M284 wrapper reads baseline metrics.AEE and checks only sample count and ordered file/sequence rows; it does not verify a baseline receipt, contract, checkpoint, config, running-BN policy, tau0 identity or sealed SHA.
findings.impact: An arbitrary same-population profile can control candidate_minus_baseline_aee and set accuracy_promoted=true, invalidating the valid825 admission gate.
findings.required_fix: Run and seal tau0 first, then create a candidate launch contract/manifest binding the baseline receipt, profile and per-frame SHA. The launcher must verify baseline receipt identities and running-BN tau0 semantics before evaluation.

findings.title: The baseline contract has no M309 fail-closed launcher
findings.evidence: The baseline reuses the generic M284 schema/wrapper. That wrapper does not enforce milestone M309_TAU0_BASELINE or policy.valid825_samples=825 at invocation; max-samples remains caller-controlled.
findings.impact: A truncated or schema-cloned run is not rejected at the contract boundary, even though its receipt will later disclose the smaller population.
findings.required_fix: Add a baseline launcher that pins the exact contract, tau0, max-samples=0, running BN, output nonexistence and all runtime identities, with duplicate-option attacks.

findings.title: Published selection scores do not exactly match the printed decimal operands
findings.evidence: Independent Decimal recomputation differs from the four published scores by approximately 2.1e-17 to 9.7e-17 because the stored score appears to use higher-precision deltas than the printed delta_aee fields.
findings.impact: The ranking and selected operator are unchanged, but the contract's exact-decimal tie language is not literally reproducible from its rows.
findings.required_fix: Store numerator and denominator as exact integer/rational fields or publish enough decimal digits and recompute scores from those frozen operands.

findings.title: Runtime accounting repair is source-proven but not yet receipt-proven on valid825
findings.evidence: The base module enforces per-call and aggregate total=exact-hit+positive-distance conservation; the selective adapter checks calls, partitions, total, exact and positive counters are all zero for disabled operators and pins the base SHA.
findings.impact: The implementation contract is sound, but no valid825 runtime receipt exists yet.
findings.required_fix: After P0 repairs, preserve per-operator and aggregate conservation fields in both sealed baseline and candidate receipts.
